categories.main_business_segments: Jiangsu Cnano Technology Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, development, production, and sales of nano-scale carbon materials and related products. Its main products include carbon nanotube powder, carbon nanotube conductive slurry, graphene composite conductive slurry, and carbon nanotube conductive masterbatch. These products are mainly applied in lithium battery fields, enhancing energy density and cycle life, and are used in new energy vehicles, energy storage batteries, and 3C electronics.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced nano-aggregation fluidized bed technology for large-scale production of carbon nanotubes, solving the global challenge of continuous mass production. It employs chemical vapor deposition with proprietary catalysts to control nanotube length, diameter, and purity. The company also developed slurry dispersion technologies to effectively integrate carbon nanotubes into lithium battery electrodes, and has pioneered single-wall carbon nanotube production, filling a domestic industry gap.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are leading domestic lithium battery manufacturers requiring high-performance conductive additives. The end markets include new energy vehicles, energy storage systems, and consumer electronics (3C products). The company also collaborates with international chemical companies for conductive plastics and explores emerging applications in carbon-based chips, wearable devices, and aerospace.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with headquarters in Zhenjiang, Jiangsu Province. It has wholly-owned subsidiaries in the UK Virgin Islands, the USA, Germany, and other domestic locations including Changzhou and Meishan. Overseas subsidiaries focus on intellectual property management and market development.
categories.supply_chain_position: Jiangsu Cnano Technology operates upstream and midstream in the lithium battery supply chain, producing key conductive materials (carbon nanotubes and conductive slurries) used by lithium battery manufacturers. It also extends downstream by developing composite cathode materials and conductive plastics, integrating vertically within the nano-carbon materials industry.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes innovation-driven growth, investing over 7.5% of revenue in R&D focused on new carbon nanotube products, dispersion technologies, and production equipment. It pursues breakthroughs in single-wall carbon nanotubes, composite cathode materials, and applications in solid-state batteries and carbon-based chips. Collaborations with top universities and research institutes support its technology leadership and patent portfolio expansion.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of carbon nanotube powders, conductive slurries, and masterbatches to lithium battery manufacturers and other industrial clients. The company also earns income from licensing its proprietary technologies and collaborates on joint ventures. Sales are mostly on a contract/order basis with long-term framework agreements.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Jiangsu Cnano Technology is the leading domestic producer of carbon nanotube conductive slurry with a market share of 53.2% in China. It has broken foreign monopolies in the lithium battery conductive additive market and holds a dominant position in production scale, customer base, and R&D capabilities. Competitors include other nano-carbon material producers and international chemical companies.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 1.448 billion, a 3.13% increase year-over-year. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 250 million, down 15.8% due to non-recurring gains in the prior year. R&D investment increased by 15.27% to RMB 109 million, representing 7.55% of revenue. Total assets reached RMB 5.14 billion, with steady growth in net assets and operating cash flow.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company offers high-performance carbon nanotube conductive materials that significantly enhance lithium battery energy density, cycle life, and charging rates compared to traditional conductive agents. Its proprietary continuous mass production technology ensures stable quality and cost advantages. Customized product formulations and strong technical support enable it to meet diverse customer needs, maintaining a competitive edge in innovation and scale.
